messages:
sam.sales: Quick heads-up — Medico is ready to move but flagged three blockers: SOC2 addendum + KMS/HSM clause, exec signature required for MSA, and dual-entity billing (US + EU). Need legal + procurement advice on routing and order form setup.

ana.legal: Noted. We can accept SOC2 attestation and add a short SOC2 schedule to the DPA. For KMS/HSM they want key custody language — propose customer-managed keys + HSM attest addendum. Exec sign for MSA is fine but we need to confirm signing order. Ping marta.procurement for invoices.

marta.procurement: For two entities we'll need either two order forms or clear tax mapping. EU entity requires VAT-based invoice. Finance prefers separate invoices (easier tax reconciliation). Is Medico ok with separate invoices? Also what's the PO cadence / net terms?

josh.se: Technical note — Medico also asked for an "interop certification" that we can prove TLS + HSM integration on their infra for Private deployment. SEs can run a validation (about 8 engineer-hours) and produce a short test report. That can be added as a SOW line item.

sam.sales: Counterparty legal is Martin Liao at Medico (cc). Martin, Medico's finance says if total > $100k they want exec sign on the MSA; order forms can be esign. Also they asked if the MSA can be wet-ink.

martin.liao (Medico Legal): We require wet-ink exec signature on the MSA; order forms may be executed electronically. Also need redaction rules for SOC2 report — we'll only accept redacted report under NDA.

ana.legal: Wet-ink for MSA only is workable. We'll draft: MSA wet-ink exec signature clause + Order Forms via DocuSign. For SOC2: we accept redacted report under NDA and will add redaction procedure language. For DPA redlines: they requested subprocessor list visibility — counterproposal: standard DPA + quarterly notice of subprocessors.

marta.procurement: Tax IDs: EU VAT 12-345678, US EIN 98-7654321. If Medico insists on consolidated invoicing, finance will need a justification for tax reconciliation; otherwise we send two invoices. Medico — is consolidated invoice a dealbreaker?

sam.sales: Medico prefers consolidated invoice but not a hard blocker. I'll ask and escalate. Also confirm: is exec wet-ink non-negotiable for you?

martin.liao (Medico Legal): Wet-ink on MSA is non-negotiable due to internal audit for pharma. Order forms electronic. Consolidated invoice is preferred but we can accept split invoices if necessary.

josh.se: About the HSM tests — propose a validation session week of May 12. We'll need a test endpoint, sample keys, and a Medico infra contact. SEs will produce a short interoperability report we can attach to the SOW.

ana.legal: I'll attach redlines by EOD: DPA (SOC2 schedule + subprocessor notice), KMS/HSM addendum language (customer-managed keys, audit logs), SLA tweak (99.9% uptime + credits table). Please review and confirm.

docusign-bot: Envelope prepared (env_90123). Recipients planned: Medico Finance, Medico Legal (Martin L.), Medico Exec, Redwood Legal, Redwood Exec. Signing order set sequential. Will send when legal confirms acceptance of redlines.

marta.procurement: Action items: confirm invoice split vs consolidated, add PO numbers for each entity, confirm net terms (Medico asked net60, finance prefers net30 -> escalate).

sam.sales: Plan: legal will send final redlines, procurement to confirm invoice flow, SE to schedule HSM validation, I'll confirm signing order and instruct DocuSign to send once redlines accepted. I'll update Martin after I hear back on consolidated invoice. :thumbsup:

martin.liao (Medico Legal): Thanks — will review redlines when received. We can provide PO numbers next business day. Also confirm: are there export control or data residency clauses we need to review for EU entity?

ana.legal: Good point — we'll add a short data residency note for EU order form and flag export control contras if any special data flows required.

sam.sales: Great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Medico infra contact for test scheduling and report back here.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from ana.legal, :eyes: from marta.procurement)
